Marker files in /tmp/ (e.g., /tmp/testing, /tmp/21cb7184-5e4e-4041-b6db-91688a974c56, /tmp/9bacc561-8485-4731-9c09-7eb4f3fae355)
network_indicators: Outbound HTTP requests to attacker-controlled URLs computed at runtime via XOR and hash functions
URL computation based on local secret file path and platform (x86_64/arm64)
Use of requests.get in setup.py during installation
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for PyPI packages whose setup.py overwrites the install command and executes code at install time. Flag packages that scan the filesystem for unusual patterns or perform hash-based checks on file paths during installation. Detect any package that downloads and executes binaries during installation, especially if the download URL is obfuscated or computed at runtime. Look for the creation of marker files in /tmp and new executables in ~/.local/bin/ with suspicious names. Network monitoring should flag outbound HTTP requests to non-standard or dynamically computed domains during package installation, particularly those generated via XOR or hash-based logic.
